name: Lafayette (Indiana, United States)
description: Divided diagonally red over white by a broad navy blue wave running from the top to the lower fly, charged with a large yellow star towards the hoist.
history: Lafayette is the county seat of Tippecanoe County, Indiana. Mayor Tony Roswarski asked the Mayor's Youth Council in 2006 to design a flag; their design was adopted by the city council on 9 April 2007 and first unveiled at a concert at Riehle Plaza on 14 June 2007.

features.role: red upper fly and lower hoist areas
broad wave from the top to the lower fly for the Wabash River
